title: oozy, rich middle-eastern shredded cheese pastry
description: a decadent, cheesy pastry dessert featuring almond paste and miso-marinated cheese, ideal for a date-night at home.
instructions: in a large mixing bowl, combine almond paste, unsalted butter, and all-purpose flour.
knead the dough until a smooth ball forms, then wrap it in parchment paper and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
meanwhile, combine shredded cheese, miso paste, heavy cream, and honey in a separate mixing bowl.
in a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, layer half of the dough followed by half of the cheese mixture.
repeat the layers, ending with the cheese mixture on top.
cover the dish with parchment paper and bake for 30 minutes.
remove the parchment paper and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
let the pastry cool for 5-10 minutes before serving.
